places.name: Niagara Falls (Niagara Parks, Clifton Hill, Fallsview)

season.note: Niagara Parks lots are paid all year; Lot C Rapidsview is seasonal (closed in winter); no overnight parking at any Niagara Parks lot (00:00 to 06:00)

rules: Niagara Parks Lot A (Falls), Lot B (Floral Showhouse) and Queen Victoria Place use a variable daily price set by month in 2026: Jan $20 or $36, Feb $25 or $30, Mar $25, Apr $25 or $30, May and Jun $35 or $40, Jul and Aug $40, Sep $30 or $40, Oct $30, Nov $25 or $30, Dec $30 or $40. Priced here at the higher figure for the month; check the chart for the day. January is usually $20; the $36 applies only on the chart's marked dates (likely New Year's).

Rapidsview Lot C (4555 Upper Rapids Blvd area): $10 for the day plus WEGO, $16 per adult and $12 per child 3 to 12 (24 h pass), about 8 min on the WEGO Green Line to Table Rock Centre; cheaper than Lot A only for a solo driver; seasonal, closes for winter (dates not published).

Most other Niagara Parks lots are $8 per hour pay and display; Rainbow Bridge lot (4348 Hiram St) is $12 per hour (not located in OSM, so not listed as a lot). Whirlpool Aero Car and Old Fort Erie lots are free.

2026 Niagara Parks Parking Pass $50 (Ontario residents, up to 2 vehicles in one household, valid to 2026-12-31) covers almost every Niagara Parks lot except the Oakes Garden Theatre/Rainbow Gardens metered lot.

City of Niagara Falls lots 4, 5, 18 and 20 near Clifton Hill and Victoria Ave: $3.00 per hour, $12.00 for 8 hours, 8 h maximum, paid daily 08:00 to 03:00, no parking 03:00 to 08:00; HONK or PayByPhone. The city's dynamic-rate by-law lets these change; flat rate in winter (amount not published).
City tourist-area street meters: $3.50 (Schedule of Fees 2026). Private lots on Clifton Hill and Stanley Ave are commonly $20 to $40 per day and rise on holiday weekends.

reservation.text: No reservation. Daily Parking Passes can be added to Niagara Parks ticket purchases online.

season.note: private garages, paid all year

rules: No City parking at the ferry docks. Nearby lots and garages are private (Waterpark Place 88 Queens Quay W, Harbour Square, Target Park, Impark), roughly $12 to $47 per day; prices are set by the operators and change often.

Cheaper: park at a GO station and take GO to Union (7 min walk to the ferry).

reservation.text: Buy ferry tickets online for the express line.

rules: Reservation required Sep 26 to Nov 8, 2026 (bookings opened Sep 17): 2-hour blocks for Dundas Peak and Tew Falls (590 Harvest Rd lot) or Webster's Falls (28 Fallsview Rd lot), or a 4-hour block for both. Personal bookings only; no buses.

Non-members: vehicle fee $11.00 + $5.50 per passenger + $10.00 reservation fee; $11 extra parking fee for the 4-hour experience ($32 for the driver). HCA members pay only the $10 reservation fee. The lot price is for the driver; each passenger adds $5.50.
Outside the reservation period visits are first come, first served (fees not stated on the HCA page).

reservation.text: Required Sep 26 to Nov 8, 2026: book online 1 to 9 days ahead, by midnight the day before; no same-day, walk-up or drive-up entry. Reservations are location specific.

lots.name: Tew Falls / Dundas Peak lot (590 Harvest Rd)
lots.notes: Sep 26 to Nov 8: $11 vehicle + $10 reservation (+$11 for the 4 h block), + $5.50 per passenger. Outside that period no reservation fee; likely $11 + $5.50 per passenger (not stated by HCA). OSM w/391692721.

lots.name: Webster's Falls lot (28 Fallsview Rd)
lots.notes: Sep 26 to Nov 8: $11 vehicle + $10 reservation (+$11 for the 4 h block), + $5.50 per passenger; 2 accessible spaces. Outside that period no reservation fee; likely $11 + $5.50 per passenger (not stated by HCA). OSM w/180201523.
